name: Billystay
description: Close the fist round the grip with the thumb along the shaft and hold the baton at forearm height to cover the ribs.

name: Light Balanceknob
description: Slide the lead foot half a pace forward and draw the rear foot up, keeping the stance narrow.

name: Truncheon Drop
description: Raise the baton over the shoulder and bring it straight down onto the opponent's forearm or collarbone.

name: Gnawing Batongrip
description: Swing the baton flat from the hip in a short level arc into the opponent's side.

name: Ready Sidebar
description: Hold the baton crosswise at chest height and knock an incoming arm or club off line.

name: Resting Shortstick
description: With the wrist through the carrying loop, keep the truncheon tight along the forearm so it shields the body and cannot be torn away.

name: Weightend Hop
description: Advance in small shuffling steps with the truncheon held upright, keeping the weight even so retreat is as quick as advance.

name: Quick Gripwrap
description: Snap the truncheon's tip down onto the opponent's forearm so that the hand drops what it holds.

name: Crackdown Husk
description: Hook the truncheon's end behind the opponent's elbow and pull, dragging the arm off its line.

name: Sharp Hardwood
description: Cut the truncheon low across the opponent's shin, staggering the lead leg.

name: Capendpause
description: Hold the truncheon level in both hands and shove forward, driving the opponent back a pace.

name: Holding Lanyardloop
description: Roll the cudgel once in the palm to settle the grip, then stand it upright beside the head as a guard.

name: Snug Balanceknob
description: Lay the free forearm along the cudgel to brace it and meet a blow with both, turning it aside.

name: Capendskitter
description: Step off the attacker's line at a slant, leaving the opponent's blow to pass the shoulder.

name: Stundrop
description: Chop the cudgel down at a slant onto the opponent's collarbone from above.

name: Narrow Capend
description: At close range, drive the cudgel's blunt butt upward into the opponent's chin or ribs.

name: Cuff Wedge
description: Catch the opponent's sleeve over the cudgel and twist, tangling the arm so it cannot swing.

name: Tight Batongrip
description: Backpedal one pace while sweeping the cudgel across the body to slap the opponent's weapon away.

name: Hooding Gripwrap
description: Carry the stick angled across the belly with a loose grip, ready to rise to guard in a heartbeat.

name: Nimble Sidebar
description: Extend the lead leg into a short lunge that closes the gap while the stick stays level.

name: Batondrop
description: Cut the stick down the centreline into the opponent's lead arm before the arm can rise.

name: Switchblow
description: Tap the stick sharply across the knuckles of the opponent's weapon hand, loosening the grip.

name: Hitching Cuff
description: Press the stick's middle against the opponent's chest and push, breaking their forward balance.

name: Tick Hop
description: Retreat two steps with the stick held across the front, the guard rising with each step.

name: Batonhusk
description: Knock the stick against the inside of a seized wrist to break the grabbing fingers open.

name: Billyhusk
description: Beat a strike aside with the stick's near end and flick the far end back into the attacker.

name: Capendlid
description: Lay the thumb straight along the shaft, locking the wrist so the baton stays rigid under impact.

name: Gnawing Rapidrap
description: Flick the wrist alone to whip the baton tip against the opponent's hand without winding up the arm.

name: Crackdown Wedge
description: Press the heel of the baton into the soft hollow of the opponent's shoulder, spoiling their swing.

name: Batonpause
description: Meet a close punch with the baton's near third and shove the arm wide before it lands.

name: Stopping Switch
description: Hook the baton's end inside the opponent's wrist and turn it outward, pinning the hand away from the body.

name: Quiet Shortstick
description: Pivot on the lead foot to turn the body away from a rush, baton already raised.

name: Capendcowl
description: Let a slow breath carry a thread of qi into the grip hand, so the baton hangs ready and steady.

name: Firm Capend
description: Rap the baton on the opponent's forearm while a thread of qi stiffens the wrist at the moment of contact.

name: Resting Truncheon
description: Raise the baton and the qi-warmed forearm together to take a blow without numbing the arm.

name: Swaying Weightend
description: Draw breath and slide forward on the in-breath, qi lightening the lead foot as it glides.

name: Upward Hardwood
description: Thrust the baton's tip into the opponent's belly below the ribs, qi gathered at the wrist.

name: Forward Switch
description: Release the breath as the baton falls from above, so the whole body's weight lands in one beat.

name: Locking Lanyardloop
description: Hook the baton behind the opponent's arm and hold the pull with even breath until the arm gives.

name: Tight Lanyardloop
description: Hold the rod diagonally across the body, the free hand steadying its middle, qi pooled low in the arms.

name: Switchbump
description: Rap the rod on the opponent's hand and step back out of reach in the same breath.

name: Sidebar Wedge
description: Slap the rod's shaft flat against an incoming blade or club, sending it wide.

name: Nimble Stun
description: Turn a quarter circle from a square stance, the hips moving first and the rod following.

name: Ticklid
description: Lever the rod across the opponent's wrist and press down, pinning the hand against a wall or table.

name: Tight Weightend
description: Run a thin thread of circulating qi through the fingers to keep the rod fixed in the grip.

name: Hard Stun
description: Swing the rod low into the outer thigh, a pulse of qi hardening the arm as it lands.

name: Folded Balanceknob
description: Meet a descending blow with the rod held crosswise and warmed with qi, so the shaft does not shake.

name: Batonskitter
description: Shuffle sideways in two short steps, qi lightening the feet so the stance never rises.

name: Quick Rapidrap
description: Bring the rod down at an angle onto the collarbone, qi sharpening the instant of contact.

name: Switchcowl
description: Hook the rod behind the opponent's neck-guard arm and heave it down, pulling their head forward.

name: Billywedge
description: Tap the rod into the crook of the elbow, so the arm folds and the strike behind it fails.

name: Batonwedge
description: Step back and sweep the rod through a covering arc that bats away whatever follows.

name: Kept Gripwrap
description: Hold the baton with an unclenched hand at the point of balance, so it answers the smallest turn of the wrist.

name: Narrow Tick
description: Place a single measured rap on the wrist bone, hard enough to spill the opponent's grip.

name: Batonlid
description: Roll the baton slowly down the opponent's forearm under steady pressure, forcing the arm to give ground.

name: Easing Stun
description: Glide forward with the weight spread evenly on both feet, so the baton hand stays unshaken.

name: Tight Truncheon
description: Swing the baton across the body from low to high to check a thrust before it arrives.

name: Firm Crackdown
description: On the way back from a parry, tap the baton against the opponent's thigh to spoil their next step.

name: Planted Hardwood
description: Match every footfall with a small shift of the stick, so guard and stance move as one body.

name: Switchstrike
description: On a settled out-breath, rap the stick across the opponent's guard hand with qi stiffening the wrist.

name: Batonstay
description: Step in and press the stick against the opponent's elbow, stopping a swing before it gains speed.

name: Flat Shortstick
description: Push off the rear foot and let the stick arrive a half beat after the hips, landing with full weight.

name: Nimble Cuff
description: Cross the rear foot behind the lead to slip past a rushing opponent's shoulder.

name: Tripping Rapidrap
description: Press the shaft across the opponent's upper arm and pin it to the chest while the feet stay planted.

name: Stun Blow
description: Flick the wrist from a still start, the stick cutting through a tight arc with almost no warning.
